en: Sign in with your Bandai Namco ID and stay signed in
See your profile, My Don, title, dan rank, score counts and favourite songs
Change My Don's costume and colours, with a preview and a history of what you wore
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
A reminder when a newer version is out
zh-Hans: 用万代南梦宫 ID 登录，并保持登录状态
查看资料、小咚、称号、段位、成绩统计和收藏曲目
更换小咚的服装与配色，保存前可以预览，也能从历史换回
界面支持英文、日文、简体中文和繁体中文
